_lore: Canon: the most power and the most flamboyant spells; learns quickly; can change allegiance if won from its master and always bonds strongly with its current owner; somewhat temperamental. Gameplay: more force and a little less control; won with one fewer defeat, accepts a new owner at once, bonds faster.
_making_canon: Affinity +1 = a pairing a famous wand carried: vine: Hermione Granger (Pottermore); walnut: Bellatrix Lestrange (DH ch.24)
_pulse_canon: dragon heartstring is 'the most prone of the three cores to accidents, being somewhat temperamental' (harrypotter.com, Wand cores): flares
